gc_diagnostic.role: Mechanism diagnosis only, not a speed comparison or formal gate.
gc_diagnostic.query_selection: Every original profile query, same dataset construction, ingest order, tokenizer warm-up and per-cohort connection lifetime as the frozen round4 profile helper. No adverse-cell selection.
gc_diagnostic.instrumentation: Identical fixed-signature forwarding wrappers around prepare_source_units and assemble_with_count, each forwarding exactly once and restoring the previous integer phase. Preallocated phase/generation counters receive only integer callback updates. Per-cell hashes use preallocated slots; serialize after the cell. Do not inspect frames, enumerate tracked objects, run cProfile/tracing, or record latency in frequency workers. Drop the runtime's latency_ms before hashing. source_prepare covers only the prepare_source_units call itself; its returned lazy resolver remains unwrapped and normally executes inside token_assembly. Do not wrap TokenCounter or tokenizer methods, whose identities certify existing runtime paths.
gc_diagnostic.record: Original default enabled/threshold/debug state; per-generation callback starts/stops/collected/uncollectable by cell and phase; before/after get_stats and get_count; all query IDs and non-timing payload hashes; source/script/data hashes; attempted/completed counts; failures and partial files. get_count is not treated as collection frequency. Record the exact Python implementation and version. get_stats/get_count are restricted to cell/worker boundaries in evaluator phase.
gc_diagnostic.binding: Before corpus execution, separately commit exact reviewed source, evaluator and tests, then a binding with all hashes and fresh output/state paths. Checkpoint every completed worker to remote Git before starting the next. Preserve any interrupted/failed worker and stop; no overwrite or retry.

decision.comparator: E relative to D only; v032 is original-baseline context, never a substitute comparator.
decision.validity: Every full payload and lifecycle invariant must match, all source/GC-state pins must hold, and every per-cell/generation/phase callback start must have its matching stop. Zero to zero is not an improvement.
decision.token_cohorts: For each cohort separately, the sum of completed (stop) generation0 plus generation1 collections in source_prepare and token_assembly across its three token configurations must be strictly lower.
decision.adverse_cell: For synthetic61/native-token1024, the same generation0 plus generation1, source_prepare plus token_assembly sum must be strictly lower.
decision.all_recall: Across all eight cells and recall_other, source_prepare and token_assembly, total completed collections of all generations must not increase; generation2 completed collections over that identical domain must not increase either. Evaluator phase is reported but excluded from these comparisons.
decision.if_not_supported: Retain E as an unselected cleanup experiment and do not run E development timing under this registration. Stop attributing the D regression to this GC-frequency hypothesis.
decision.if_supported: A supportive pattern permits one separately registered E development profile/paired attempt. It only demonstrates changed collection frequency under identical instrumentation; it neither proves the cause of the old D p50 regression nor establishes any speed benefit.

conditional_development: Only after a supportive independently audited GC result, commit a separate E development intent and run the unchanged 4732-call profile and 4096-call paired helper once in fresh candidate-e paths. Keep every negative cell. If selected later, bind this addendum with all prior registrations in all three evaluators before formal/compatibility execution.
